name: Nipponese Expedition
source: WEB, Grade 2a warband, converted from mordheimer.net (/docs/warbands/grade-2a-warbands/nipponese-expedition) on 2026-10-10.

heroSlots.notes: A Nipponese noble commanding the expedition. Each warband must have exactly one.

specialRules.name: Ride
specialRules.description: Has the Ride skill as detailed in the Blazing Saddles article (may ride horses and warhorses).

heroSlots.notes: The warband's spiritual and magical leader. 0-1. May never carry any equipment except a walking staff (club) and a dagger.

specialRules.note: Arcane Vim-Toist: casts Vim-Toist Magic (Arabian Elemental Magic) and starts with one spell from it.

specialRules.name: Tenants of the Order
specialRules.description: Apart from a walking staff (club) and a dagger, the Vim-To Mage may never have any equipment.

specialRules.name: Infiltration
specialRules.description: Always set up after the opposing warband, out of enemy sight and more than 12" from any enemy model. If both warbands have infiltrators, each player rolls a D6 and the lower roll sets up first.

specialRules.name: Loner
specialRules.description: May never become the leader of the warband.

heroSlots.notes: Sworn samurai retainers of the Hatamoto. 0-2.

specialRules.name: Ride
specialRules.description: Has the Ride skill as detailed in the Blazing Saddles article (may ride horses and warhorses).

henchmenTypes.notes: Common foot soldiers. Any number, hired in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: Wall of Steel
specialRules.description: May wield a spear (Yari) two-handed; it then gains the Parry rule.

henchmenTypes.notes: Female warriors who guard the castle. 0-2.

specialRules.name: Wardens of the Castle
specialRules.description: Causes Fear while inside buildings or ruins. Agree before the battle which terrain counts.

henchmenTypes.notes: Fighting monks travelling with the expedition. 0-3.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Katana
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Close combat. No profile is printed on the source page (cost 20 gc only).

exclusiveEquipment.name: Kanabo
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Close combat, Strength as user +1. Two-handed: may not be used with a shield, buckler or second weapon in close combat (a shield still gives +1 armour save against shooting). Concussion: injury rolls of 2-4 are treated as Stunned.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Sashimono
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: The wearer may re-roll any failed Leadership test that is not a Rout test, but must keep the second result.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Nagamaki (Cathayan Longsword)
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Close combat. Listed as a Cathayan Longsword; no profile is printed on the source page.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Horo
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Hatamoto and Retainers only (Noble list); only works while mounted.
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: While mounted on a horse or warhorse, the wearer gets +1 to all armour saves against ranged attacks (a 6+ save if no other armour is worn).

exclusiveEquipment.name: Kusarigama
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Close combat, Strength as user. Two-handed: may not be used with a shield, buckler or second weapon in close combat. Cannot be parried by swords or bucklers. Chain Strike: a model armed with a Kusarigama that is not engaged in combat may knock down enemies that fail a charge against it, or that charge friendly models within 3".

exclusiveEquipment.name: Fighting Claws
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Close combat. No profile is printed on the source page (cost 35 gc only).

exclusiveEquipment.name: Blow Pipe
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Missile weapon. No profile is printed on the source page (cost 25 gc only).

specialRules: Hired Swords: The warband may hire the same Hired Swords as Human Mercenary warbands. | Strategic Minded: The warband may choose to make a voluntary Rout after suffering one fewer casualty than normal. | Nipponese Names: Tanto is a dagger, Wakizashi a sword, Yari a spear, Naginata a halberd, Hankyu a short bow, Yumi a bow, Teppo a handgun, Shuriken throwing stars and Sai a sword breaker. The first Tanto is free, further ones cost 2 gc. | Henchmen Groups: Henchmen are hired in groups of 1 to 5 and start with 0 Experience.
